content.description:
We are here to take your native currency from all over the world to it's limit by converting it to Puzzle tokens and taking that to your marketplace of choice. Puzzle will not allow your government to devalue your currency, as the fair market will determine the value, growing steadily over time. The ultimate goal of Puzzle is to create an asset that not only holds value against inflation and negative government activities all over the world, but has steady increases in value.

Puzzle is here to create the alternative currency for all who seek the ability to create change and hold their financial power in their hands.
